title: Broadway in Columbia Co. announces 26/27 line-up - NewsBreak
text:
By D.V. Wise No media credit provided. ,
13 hours ago
EVANS, Ga. (WJBF) – Nederlander National Markets, in partnership with the Columbia County Performing Arts Center announced the 2026-2027 Broadway season in Columbia County.
The season debuts with Tony Award®-winning, original Broadway sensation JERSEY BOYS in November and ends with Beetlejuice in June.
2026-2027 Season Performance Dates
Jersey Boys
Tuesday, November 24, 2026
A Beautiful Noise
Wednesday, January 13, 2027
The Wiz
Thursday, February 4, 2027
Waitress
Monday, March 1, 2027
Legally Blonde
Tuesday, May 4, 2027
Beetlejuice
Wednesday, June 9, 2027
Thursday, June 10, 2027
Subscriptions are on sale now! Current subscribers can renew, and new subscribers can purchase their season tickets at TheCenterOfCC.com/Broadway .
The Box Office can also be reached via email at ccpacboxoffice@columbiacountyga.gov .
